name: Arya Dwija Sutha

items: A background in Information Systems, and now a living from sales — B2B, at Astragraphia. That mostly means sitting with a business, asking what they print, how much of it, who has to deal with it, and what it costs them. Then finding something that actually fits.
Outside work, the building doesn't stop. Sometimes a website, sometimes a small tool to save an hour, and lately a lot of it is AI.
The pull is toward technology, how businesses really work, and what happens when the two meet.

rows: Business Consultant at PT Astra Graphia Tbk

blocks.title: PT Astra Graphia Tbk
body: The selling covers Fujifilm multifunction machines, printing setups, and document workflows. The businesses vary — a print shop, a factory, a hotel — but the question underneath is always the same: what do they print, how much of it, and who has to deal with it.
That gets looked at first, before any spec sheet. Half the time the machine they ask for isn't the one they need.

Along the way a few tools were built to keep the same paperwork from happening twice: a [quotation generator](projects.html#quotation), the [Machine In Field dashboard & database](projects.html#mif), and a [Visit Logger Bot](projects.html#visit-logger).
blocks.figures: 38 deals · 18 new-business wins · IDR 519M minimum ARR · 47 devices placed

blocks.title: Krona Digital Marketing Agency
body: Pages built in WordPress and Elementor, turning designs into working websites.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lede: A few things built, worked on, or made to solve problems in day-to-day work.

blocks.title: Visit Logger Bot
body: Sales means a lot of small things worth remembering — a visit, a call, something a customer mentioned in passing. By the end of the day, the last thing on the list is opening a spreadsheet and typing it all in again.
So a Telegram bot handles it: it takes what happened, in plain words, sorts it into records, sets the follow-up, and drafts the WhatsApp message. The boring part is handled.

blocks.title: Quotation Generator
body: Every quotation followed the same routine. Open an old Word file, swap the machine photos, retype the prices, then do the whole thing again in Indonesian. It got old fast.
Now it takes the machines, the customer, the terms, and hands back a Word file and a PDF in either language. If a customer comes back, reopening the old quotation beats starting from zero.

blocks.title: Machine In Field
body: The machine data on file is genuinely useful, but it lives in spreadsheets that were never meant to be a database. Every month, the same sorting came around, matching accounts to whoever handles them. Again.

So a console was built. It remembers who owns what, so next month most of it is already done, and it keeps the history straight when a machine moves to a new customer. A monthly chore became something actually usable.

blocks.title: Ecolodges Indonesia
body: The Ecolodges Indonesia site, a conservation tourism business, was rebuilt — pages, content, structure — with analytics set up to show how people were finding it.
Over the stretch that was tracked, monthly search impressions went from around 50,000 to over 100,000, and average position from 15 to 6.

blocks.title: Hermes
body: Hermes has been the way to build things that couldn't be built alone. It's where an idea gets tried, gets stuck, gets worked through, and ends up running.
Where it's good and where it isn't takes time to learn. Some days that's a tool, some days a workflow, some days just finding out an idea doesn't work.
The point is getting from “could that even be built” to actually having it.

blocks.title: Universitas Airlangga
blocks.meta: Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems · GPA 3.74/4.00
body: The coursework covers software development, enterprise architecture, IT governance, data analysis — the technical side, and the business side of it.
The final project was a JavaScript dashboard for monitoring employee KPIs, built around a state electricity company's East Java distribution unit.
2022 also brought the Chief of HIMSI Sistem Informasi UNAIR role.
